Create a fully independent invented landscape; do not use an existing body texture or any ALMA image as terrain. Broad neutral charcoal-grey palette is artistic, not calibrated S-type colour or measured composition. Sparse subdued irregular blocks and shallow relief are invented; no distinctive named craters or mapped features. No spacecraft, people, trees, ocean, exposed interior, plume or atmosphere. Black sky is an artistic assumption, not proof of atmospheric absence. Solar illumination comes from off frame; exposure, shadows and colour are artistic. Wide 16:9 composition. Two clearly legible footer lines in a dark band: "IMAGINED SKY FROM ASTEROID (3) JUNO" and "Terrain, materials, horizon and lighting are hypothetical; no dated site registration." Frame a broad low, gently uneven invented horizon with modest fractured slabs at the bottom and a large empty black sky. Sun entirely off frame, no other visible astronomical disks, no star field or numerical scale. This is a hypothetical observer orientation, not a mapped surface normal or spin phase.
